resources.string: Add a widget or a shortcut that opens a service on your local network with one tap.
Your launcher cannot add widgets from here. Long-press the home screen and choose Widgets.
Open a discovered local network service
Choose which protocols are scanned for when you add a widget or shortcut. Existing widgets keep working if a protocol is disabled.
No protocols are enabled. Enable some under Protocols on the main screen.
Delete %1$s? Widgets and shortcuts that use it will copy the address to the clipboard instead of opening it.
Enter a URL scheme using only letters, digits, +, - and .
The name the service advertises over mDNS. For example, MQTT services advertise as mqtt.
The start of the address to open, which Android uses to pick an app (for example mqtt for mqtt://). The matching app must be installed.
Enter a protocol name and URL scheme using only letters, digits and hyphens. The protocol must not already be listed.
This launcher does not support adding shortcuts
No services found. Check the hotspot connection and scan again.
Could not scan for services. Check local network access and try again.
Local network access is required to discover services.
This widget has no selected service. Remove it and add it again.
Could not find %1$s on the current network.
Could not resolve %1$s. Try again when the service is available.
No app could open this service. Its address was copied to the clipboard.
